blocks.zh: 實驗室控制、記錄與投訴文件
blocks.en: Laboratory Controls, Records and Complaint Files

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 §211.160–§211.165 實驗室控制的科學合理性要求，理解「測試不能確保品質」的 Deming 原則，及 ICH Q2(R1) 方法驗證的接軌
blocks.en: Understand the scientific-soundness requirements for laboratory controls in §211.160–§211.165, the Deming principle that "testing cannot assure quality", and how method validation aligns with ICH Q2(R1)

blocks.zh: 解釋 §211.166 穩定性測試計畫的法規框架，對應 ICH Q1A(R2) 實際時間 vs. 加速試驗設計，識別 CDMO 情境下穩定性計畫的所有權問題
blocks.en: Explain the regulatory framework for the §211.166 stability testing program, how it maps to ICH Q1A(R2) real-time vs. accelerated study design, and recognize the stability program ownership question in a CDMO setting

blocks.zh: 理解 §211.188 批次生產與控制記錄（Batch Production Record）的完整要素，作為電子批次記錄（eBR）設計的法律基礎
blocks.en: Understand the complete elements of the §211.188 Batch Production and Control Record, the legal basis for electronic batch record (eBR) design

blocks.zh: 精通 §211.192 生產記錄審查的「thorough review」標準——這是 FDA 警告信中引用頻率最高的 CGMP 條款
blocks.en: Master the "thorough review" standard of §211.192 production record review, the CGMP provision cited most often in FDA warning letters

blocks.zh: 掌握 §211.194 OOS 調查的 Phase I/Phase II 框架（FDA 2006 OOS Guidance），理解 Barr Laboratories 案例的歷史影響
blocks.en: Understand the Phase I/Phase II framework for §211.194 OOS investigations (FDA 2006 OOS Guidance) and the historical impact of the Barr Laboratories case

blocks.zh: 辨別 §211.198 投訴文件的完整要求，區分一般投訴與 MedWatch 強制申報義務，識別 CDMO 情境下的責任分工
blocks.en: Identify the complete requirements for §211.198 complaint files, distinguish ordinary complaints from mandatory MedWatch reporting obligations, and recognize the division of responsibilities in a CDMO setting

blocks.zh: 5.1 §§ 211.160–211.165 — Laboratory Controls: Scientific Soundness & Release Testing 5.1 §§ 211.160–211.165 — 實驗室管制：科學健全性與放行檢驗
blocks.en: 5.1 §§ 211.160–211.165 — Laboratory Controls: Scientific Soundness & Release Testing

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: Deming 原則：「測試無法確保品質」
blocks.en: The Deming Principle: "Testing Cannot Assure Quality"

blocks.zh: W. Edwards Deming 的第三點原則："Cease dependence on inspection to achieve quality." 測試是落後指標（lagging indicator）——它能偵測已產生的缺陷，但無法防止缺陷的產生。
blocks.en: W. Edwards Deming's third principle: "Cease dependence on inspection to achieve quality." Testing is a lagging indicator: it can detect defects that have already occurred, but it cannot prevent them.

blocks.zh: 這正是 CGMP 強調「製程驗證」（Process Validation, §211.100 + FDA 2011 Guidance）的哲學基礎：品質必須被設計進產品，而不是靠測試「篩出來」。
blocks.en: This is the philosophical basis for CGMP's emphasis on process validation (§211.100 + FDA 2011 Guidance): quality must be designed into the product, not "screened out" by testing.

blocks.zh: 實務意義：一個批次的所有檢驗全部合格，並不代表製程受控。若製程發生漂移（drift），下一批次可能不合格——而測試無法提前警告你。持續製程監控（CPV, Continued Process Verification）才是答案。
blocks.en: Practical meaning: a batch that passes every test does not mean the process is in control. If the process drifts, the next batch may fail, and testing cannot warn you in advance. Continued Process Verification (CPV) is the answer.

blocks.zh: 方法驗證接軌：ICH Q2(R1) + USP <1225>/<1226>
blocks.en: Method Validation Alignment: ICH Q2(R1) + USP <1225>/<1226>

blocks.zh: §211.160(b)(3) 和 §211.165(e) 都要求建立並文件化測試方法的準確性、靈敏度、專一性與重現性。
blocks.en: §211.160(b)(3) and §211.165(e) both require that the accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility of test methods be established and documented.

blocks.zh: FDA 接受以下框架作為驗證依據：
blocks.en: FDA accepts the following frameworks as the basis for validation:

blocks.zh: ICH Q2(R1)： 分析方法驗證——特性、標準、測試程序（適用於所有方法類型）
blocks.en: ICH Q2(R1): Validation of analytical procedures: characteristics, criteria, and test procedures (applicable to all method types)

blocks.zh: USP <1225>： 藥典分析程序驗證
blocks.en: USP <1225>: Validation of compendial procedures

blocks.zh: USP <1226>： 分析程序驗證——針對 USP 收錄程序的驗證方法
blocks.en: USP <1226>: Verification of compendial procedures, the approach for procedures that appear in the USP

blocks.zh: CDMO 重點：如果 CDMO 使用客戶提供的方法，CDMO 仍須對方法進行轉移驗證（Method Transfer Verification），證明其實驗室能重現客戶的驗證結果。方法轉移失敗是常見的 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: CDMO focus: if a CDMO uses a method supplied by the client, the CDMO must still perform method transfer verification to show that its laboratory can reproduce the client's validation results. Failed method transfers are a common 483 observation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 批次放行前核查清單
blocks.en: CDMO Pre-Release Checklist for a Batch

blocks.zh: 所有成品檢驗（identity、strength、purity、sterility 等）已完成且合規
blocks.en: All finished product tests (identity, strength, purity, sterility, etc.) are completed and compliant

blocks.zh: 所有 OOS/OOT 結果已完成調查，有合理可接受的結論
blocks.en: All OOS/OOT results have been investigated, with a justified and acceptable conclusion

blocks.zh: 批次生產記錄（§211.188）已完成且無未結案偏差
blocks.en: The batch production record (§211.188) is complete with no open deviations

blocks.zh: 原料、容器/蓋子的放行測試符合規格（§211.184）
blocks.en: Release testing of raw materials and containers/closures meets specifications (§211.184)

blocks.zh: 生產記錄已由 QCU 完成 thorough review（§211.192）
blocks.en: The production records have undergone thorough review by the QCU (§211.192)

blocks.zh: 客戶/品牌商的品質協議規定的額外放行條件已滿足
blocks.en: Any additional release conditions in the quality agreement with the client/brand owner have been met

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CGMP 實驗室 vs. GLP 實驗室 — 關鍵差異
blocks.en: Core Concept: CGMP Laboratory vs. GLP Laboratory: Key Differences

blocks.zh: CGMP（21 CFR 211）： 針對商業量產批次的放行測試，目的是確認每個批次符合預先建立的規格。監管對象是成品藥廠（FDF manufacturer）。
blocks.en: CGMP (21 CFR 211): Release testing of commercial-scale batches, intended to confirm that every batch meets pre-established specifications. It regulates finished dosage form (FDF) manufacturers.

blocks.zh: GLP（21 CFR 58）： 針對安全性研究（毒理、動物試驗）的數據可信度框架，確保 IND/NDA 申請資料的完整性。監管對象是非臨床研究機構。
blocks.en: GLP (21 CFR 58): A framework for the reliability of data from safety studies (toxicology, animal studies), ensuring the integrity of data in IND/NDA submissions. It regulates nonclinical research facilities.

blocks.zh: 兩者可能同時存在於同一棟建築——例如一家同時做研發和商業生產的公司——但規定彼此獨立，不可混用。
blocks.en: The two may exist in the same building (for example, a company that does both R&D and commercial manufacturing), but the requirements are independent and must not be mixed.

blocks.zh: 5.2 §211.166 — Stability Testing: The Expiration Date Evidence Base 5.2 §211.166 — 安定性試驗：有效期限的科學依據
blocks.en: 5.2 §211.166 — Stability Testing: The Expiration Date Evidence Base

blocks.zh: 常見 483 觀察項目：
blocks.en: Common 483 observations:

blocks.zh: 穩定性計畫書（written testing program）缺乏統計學依據
blocks.en: The written stability testing program lacks a statistical basis

blocks.zh: 未按計畫執行測試，或測試間隔未遵守
blocks.en: Testing not performed according to the program, or testing intervals not followed

blocks.zh: 加速試驗數據支持的有效期未以實際試驗驗證
blocks.en: Expiry dating supported by accelerated data and not confirmed by real-time studies

blocks.zh: 容器封閉系統與上市包裝不同（不符合 §211.166(a)(4)）
blocks.en: The container closure system differs from the marketed package (non-compliant with §211.166(a)(4))

blocks.zh: 穩定性樣品貯存條件未按規格監控
blocks.en: Storage conditions of stability samples not monitored against specification

blocks.zh: ICH Q1A(R2) 穩定性試驗協議設計
blocks.en: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Study Protocol Design

blocks.zh: §211.166 提供法規框架，ICH Q1A(R2)（Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products）提供具體的科學方法論。FDA 認可此指引作為 §211.166 的履行方式。
blocks.en: §211.166 provides the regulatory framework, and ICH Q1A(R2) (Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products) provides the specific scientific methodology. FDA recognizes this guideline as a way of meeting §211.166.

blocks.zh: 長期試驗（Long-term / Real-time）：
blocks.en: Long-term (real-time) studies:

blocks.zh: 溫帶氣候帶（Zone I/II）：25°C ± 2°C / 60% RH ± 5% RH，最低 12 個月
blocks.en: Temperate climatic zones (Zone I/II): 25°C ± 2°C / 60% RH ± 5% RH, minimum 12 months

blocks.zh: 熱帶氣候帶（Zone III/IV）：30°C ± 2°C / 65% RH 或 75% RH
blocks.en: Hot climatic zones (Zone III/IV): 30°C ± 2°C / 65% RH or 75% RH

blocks.zh: 測試頻率：0、3、6、9、12 個月，之後每年一次
blocks.en: Testing frequency: 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 months, then annually

blocks.zh: 加速試驗（Accelerated）：
blocks.en: Accelerated studies:

blocks.zh: 40°C ± 2°C / 75% RH ± 5% RH，最少 6 個月
blocks.en: 40°C ± 2°C / 75% RH ± 5% RH, minimum 6 months

blocks.zh: 如 6 個月加速數據出現顯著變化（significant change），需加入中間條件（30°C/65% RH）
blocks.en: If a significant change occurs within the 6-month accelerated data, an intermediate condition (30°C/65% RH) must be added

blocks.zh: 當一個藥品有多種強度或包裝規格時，對所有組合進行完整穩定性試驗既昂貴又不必要。ICH Q1D 允許兩種簡化設計：
blocks.en: When a drug product has multiple strengths or package sizes, running a full stability study on every combination is both costly and unnecessary. ICH Q1D permits two reduced designs:

blocks.zh: Bracketing（括弧設計）： 只測試「最極端」的強度和（或）容量，中間規格的穩定性由此推斷。前提：同一劑型、相同製程、同一容器系統。
blocks.en: Bracketing: Only the extremes of strength and/or fill size are tested, and the stability of the intermediate presentations is inferred from them. Prerequisite: the same dosage form, the same process, and the same container closure system.

blocks.zh: Matrixing（矩陣設計）： 在每個時間點只測試部分樣品的子集，但最終每個批次/強度/包裝的每個時間點都有數據。適用於已知影響因素可量化的產品。
blocks.en: Matrixing: At each time point only a subset of the samples is tested, but in the end every batch/strength/package has data at every time point. It suits products whose influencing factors are known and quantifiable.

blocks.zh: 風險：如果矩陣設計中某一格出現意外不合格，整個矩陣可能需要補測，成本反而更高。
blocks.en: Risk: if an unexpected failure occurs in one cell of the matrix, the whole matrix may need to be supplemented with additional testing, which can end up costing more.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：穩定性計畫的所有權
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Ownership of the Stability Program

blocks.zh: 這是 CDMO 業務中最常產生爭議的 GMP 議題之一。法規立場清楚：
blocks.en: This is one of the GMP topics that most often causes disputes in CDMO business. The regulatory position is clear:

blocks.zh: §211.166 要求持有 drug product 的「establishment」（廠商）建立穩定性計畫。 在 CDMO 架構下：
blocks.en: §211.166 requires the establishment that holds the drug product to set up the stability program. In a CDMO arrangement:

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 是 NDA/ANDA 持有者（505(b)(2)）： CDMO 完全負責穩定性計畫
blocks.en: If the CDMO is the NDA/ANDA holder (505(b)(2)): the CDMO is fully responsible for the stability program

blocks.zh: 若品牌商（Brand Owner）是 NDA 持有者，CDMO 是製造商： 品牌商負責穩定性計畫設計和有效期決定；CDMO 負責提供代表性批次用於穩定性，並配合執行。
blocks.en: If the brand owner is the NDA holder and the CDMO is the manufacturer: the brand owner is responsible for stability program design and the expiry dating decision; the CDMO is responsible for supplying representative batches for stability and supporting execution.

blocks.zh: 品質協議中必須明訂： 誰負責年度回顧、誰分析傾向數據、誰決定效期縮短。
blocks.en: The quality agreement must specify: who is responsible for the annual review, who analyzes trend data, and who decides on shortening the expiry period.

blocks.zh: 有效期（Shelf Life）計算邏輯
blocks.en: Shelf Life Calculation Logic

blocks.zh: 有效期不是「猜測」，而是統計計算的結果。標準方法（ICH Q1E）：
blocks.en: Shelf life is not a "guess" but the result of a statistical calculation. The standard approach (ICH Q1E):

blocks.zh: 選擇適當的降解模型（線性、Arrhenius 動力學等）
blocks.en: Select an appropriate degradation model (linear, Arrhenius kinetics, etc.)

blocks.zh: 對長期實時數據進行線性迴歸
blocks.en: Perform linear regression on the long-term real-time data

blocks.zh: 計算預測區間（prediction interval）
blocks.en: Calculate the prediction interval

blocks.zh: 找出 95% 單側置信下限（one-sided lower confidence limit）與接受規格交叉的時間點
blocks.en: Find the time at which the 95% one-sided lower confidence limit crosses the acceptance specification

blocks.zh: 該時間點即為有效期的最大允許值
blocks.en: That time point is the maximum permissible shelf life

blocks.zh: 商業決策（申請的有效期）可短於統計計算值，但不可超過。
blocks.en: A business decision (the proposed shelf life) may be shorter than the statistically calculated value, but it may not exceed it.

blocks.zh: 5.3 §211.188 — Batch Production and Control Records: The Complete Manufacturing History 5.3 §211.188 — 批次生產與管制紀錄：完整製造歷程
blocks.en: 5.3 §211.188 — Batch Production and Control Records: The Complete Manufacturing History

blocks.zh: 無菌注射劑的特殊批次記錄要求
blocks.en: Special Batch Record Expectations for Sterile Injectables

blocks.zh: §211.188 是所有劑型的通用要求。對於無菌注射劑（Sterile Injectables），FDA 查廠實務上還期望在批次記錄中看到：
blocks.en: §211.188 is a general requirement for all dosage forms. For sterile injectables, in practice FDA inspectors also expect to see the following in the batch record:

blocks.zh: 環境監控數據（EM）： 生產當日的粒子計數、微生物採樣結果，應連結到批次記錄
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (EM) data: Particle counts and microbial sampling results from the day of production, linked to the batch record

blocks.zh: 過濾器完整性測試（Filter Integrity Test）： 無菌過濾前後的起泡點（Bubble Point）或擴散流（Diffusive Flow）結果
blocks.en: Filter integrity test: Bubble point or diffusive flow results before and after sterile filtration

blocks.zh: 培養基灌裝合格狀態（Media Fill Qualification Status）： 確認該批次的無菌操作員均通過最近一次培養基灌裝
blocks.en: Media fill qualification status: Confirmation that the aseptic operators for the batch all passed the most recent media fill

blocks.zh: 滅菌週期記錄（Sterilization Cycle Record）： F₀ 值、溫度-時間曲線圖——作為批次記錄的附件
blocks.en: Sterilization cycle record: F₀ value and temperature-time chart, attached to the batch record

blocks.zh: 凍乾曲線（Lyophilization Cycle，若適用）： 每批次的完整壓力-溫度圖表
blocks.en: Lyophilization cycle (if applicable): The complete pressure-temperature chart for each batch

blocks.zh: eBR（電子批次記錄）的法律設計基礎
blocks.en: Legal Design Basis for the eBR (Electronic Batch Record)

blocks.zh: §211.188 是所有電子批次記錄（Electronic Batch Record, eBR）系統的法律設計藍圖。每一個 eBR 欄位都必須對應 §211.188(b) 的某一子項。
blocks.en: §211.188 is the legal design blueprint for every electronic batch record (eBR) system. Every eBR field must map to a sub-item of §211.188(b).

blocks.zh: eBR 系統驗證（按 21 CFR Part 11）時，通常會製作一份「規格追溯矩陣（Traceability Matrix）」：
blocks.en: When validating an eBR system (per 21 CFR Part 11), a requirements traceability matrix is usually prepared:

blocks.zh: ALCOA+ 數據完整性框架
blocks.en: The ALCOA+ Data Integrity Framework

blocks.zh: 所有批次記錄（紙本或電子）都必須符合 ALCOA+ 原則——FDA 2018 Data Integrity Guidance 和 MHRA/WHO 相關指引所共同認可的框架：
blocks.en: All batch records (paper or electronic) must comply with the ALCOA+ principles, a framework jointly recognized by the FDA 2018 Data Integrity Guidance and the relevant MHRA/WHO guidance:

blocks.zh: 5.4 §211.192 — Production Record Review: Batch Disposition Decision 5.4 §211.192 — 生產紀錄審查：批次處置決策
blocks.en: 5.4 §211.192 — Production Record Review: Batch Disposition Decision

blocks.zh:
§211.192 是 FDA 警告信引用最頻繁的 CGMP 條款。 幾乎每一封涉及品質體系的警告信都包含此條款的違反指控。常見引用語句：
  • "Your firm failed to thoroughly investigate an out-of-specification (OOS) result…"
  • "Your investigation was not extended to other batches…"
  • "Your investigation did not include a written record of conclusions and follow-up…"
  • "You released a batch prior to completing your investigation…"
blocks.en:
§211.192 is the CGMP provision most frequently cited in FDA warning letters. Almost every warning letter involving the quality system includes an alleged violation of this provision. Commonly cited statements:
  • "Your firm failed to thoroughly investigate an out-of-specification (OOS) result…"
  • "Your investigation was not extended to other batches…"
  • "Your investigation did not include a written record of conclusions and follow-up…"
  • "You released a batch prior to completing your investigation…"

blocks.zh: 「Thorough Review」標準的實務含義
blocks.en: What the "Thorough Review" Standard Means in Practice

blocks.zh: §211.192 要求 QCU 進行「thorough review」——但法規沒有定義「thorough」。FDA 查廠和警告信揭示了以下的期望：
blocks.en: §211.192 requires the QCU to perform a "thorough review", but the regulation does not define "thorough". FDA inspections and warning letters reveal the following expectations:

blocks.zh: Thorough review 的意思是：
blocks.en: Thorough review means:

blocks.zh: 不只是「簽名確認」——QCU 必須真正閱讀並理解每一項記錄
blocks.en: More than "signing to confirm": the QCU must actually read and understand every record

blocks.zh: 主動識別「在規格內但接近邊界」的結果（OOT，Out of Trend）
blocks.en: Proactively identifying results that are "within specification but close to the limit" (OOT, Out of Trend)

blocks.zh: 確認每一個計畫外的事件（unplanned event）都有偏差報告
blocks.en: Confirming that every unplanned event has a deviation report

blocks.zh: 確認每一個偏差都有完成的 CAPA，且 CAPA 的有效性已驗證
blocks.en: Confirming that every deviation has a completed CAPA and that the effectiveness of the CAPA has been verified

blocks.zh: 對收率偏差（yield discrepancy）進行數量對帳（reconciliation）
blocks.en: Performing quantity reconciliation for any yield discrepancy

blocks.zh: 確認標籤對帳（label reconciliation）已完成
blocks.en: Confirming that label reconciliation has been completed

blocks.zh: 「已放行後發現問題」的特殊情況
blocks.en: The Special Case of "Problems Found After Release"

blocks.zh: §211.192 有一句關鍵詞："whether or not the batch has already been distributed"（無論批次是否已經放行）。
blocks.en: §211.192 contains a key phrase: "whether or not the batch has already been distributed" (regardless of whether the batch has already been released).

blocks.zh: 這意味著：
blocks.en: This means:

blocks.zh: 批次放行後發現的問題必須照樣調查
blocks.en: Problems found after batch release must still be investigated

blocks.zh: 調查結論可能導致市場召回（Recall），應通知 FDA
blocks.en: The investigation conclusion may lead to a market recall, and FDA should be notified

blocks.zh: 不能因為「批次已經賣出去了」就不調查或降低調查深度
blocks.en: You cannot skip the investigation or reduce its depth because "the batch has already been sold"

blocks.zh: CDMO 在客戶要求盡快結案的壓力下，仍必須堅持完整調查——這是 QCU 的法定責任
blocks.en: Even under pressure from the client to close quickly, the CDMO must insist on a complete investigation; this is the QCU's legal responsibility

blocks.zh: CDMO 批次放行權：QCU 的不可讓渡職責
blocks.en: CDMO Batch Release Authority: A Non-Transferable QCU Responsibility

blocks.zh: §211.192 規定批次由 quality control unit（QCU）審查和批准——不是客戶（品牌商）、不是業務單位、不是生產部門。
blocks.en: §211.192 provides that batches are reviewed and approved by the quality control unit (QCU): not the client (brand owner), not the commercial unit, not the production department.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 實務中，這有重要的法律含義：
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, this has important legal implications:

blocks.zh: 品牌商可以在品質協議中要求參與批次審查，但最終放行決定必須由 CDMO 的 QCU 做出
blocks.en: The brand owner may require participation in batch review in the quality agreement, but the final release decision must be made by the CDMO's QCU

blocks.zh: 如果客戶說「這個批次可以放」但 CDMO 的 QCU 有未結偏差，CDMO 不可以放行
blocks.en: If the client says "this batch can be released" but the CDMO's QCU has open deviations, the CDMO may not release it

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時，CDMO 對放行的每一個批次負全責，即使客戶施壓
blocks.en: During an FDA inspection, the CDMO is fully responsible for every batch it released, even if the client applied pressure

blocks.zh: 品質協議應明訂：客戶有「審查意見」的權利，但沒有「覆蓋 QCU 決定」的權利
blocks.en: The quality agreement should specify that the client has the right to give "review comments", but no right to "override the QCU decision"

blocks.zh: 最常見的 §211.192 違規模式（根據 FDA 警告信資料庫分析）：
blocks.en: The most common §211.192 violation patterns (based on analysis of the FDA warning letter database):

blocks.zh: 調查不完整（Incomplete Investigation）： 未確認根本原因，以「原因不明」結案
blocks.en: Incomplete investigation: The root cause was not identified, and the investigation was closed as "cause unknown"

blocks.zh: 延伸調查不足： OOS 只調查該批次，未延伸到同生產期間的其他批次
blocks.en: Inadequate extension of the investigation: An OOS was investigated only for that batch and not extended to other batches from the same production period

blocks.zh: CAPA 無效性： 同樣的偏差類型反覆出現，CAPA 未曾解決根本問題
blocks.en: CAPA ineffectiveness: The same type of deviation recurs repeatedly, and the CAPA never resolved the root problem

blocks.zh: 收率偏差未調查： 超過 MPR 設定範圍的收率偏差未觸發偏差報告
blocks.en: Yield deviations not investigated: A yield deviation beyond the range set in the MPR did not trigger a deviation report

blocks.zh: 批次放行前調查未結： 以「初步調查結論」放行，未等完整調查完成
blocks.en: Investigation not closed before batch release: The batch was released on a "preliminary investigation conclusion" without waiting for the full investigation to finish

blocks.zh: 偏差調查結案的標準
blocks.en: Criteria for Closing a Deviation Investigation

blocks.zh: FDA 對「incomplete investigation」的定義相當嚴格：
blocks.en: FDA's definition of an "incomplete investigation" is quite strict:

blocks.zh: 5.5 §211.194 — Laboratory Records: OOS Investigation Requirements 5.5 §211.194 — 實驗室紀錄：超出規格調查要求
blocks.en: 5.5 §211.194 — Laboratory Records: OOS Investigation Requirements

blocks.zh: §211.194 最常見的 483 觀察項目：
blocks.en: The most common 483 observations under §211.194:

blocks.zh: "OOS results were not investigated prior to retesting"（最嚴重）
blocks.en: "OOS results were not investigated prior to retesting" (the most serious)

blocks.zh: OOS 調查程序：FDA 2006 OOS Guidance 框架
blocks.en: OOS Investigation Procedure: The FDA 2006 OOS Guidance Framework

blocks.zh: FDA 在 2006 年發布了 "Investigating Out-of-Specification (OOS) Test Results for Pharmaceutical Production" 指引，為業界提供了明確的調查框架。此指引被廣泛視為 §211.192 + §211.194 的執行細節。
blocks.en: In 2006 FDA issued the guidance "Investigating Out-of-Specification (OOS) Test Results for Pharmaceutical Production", giving industry a clear investigation framework. The guidance is widely regarded as the implementation detail for §211.192 + §211.194.

blocks.zh: Phase I — 實驗室調查（Laboratory Investigation）
blocks.en: Phase I: Laboratory Investigation

blocks.zh: 由實驗室主管（Laboratory Supervisor）進行，時限通常為 5–10 個工作日：
blocks.en: Conducted by the Laboratory Supervisor, usually within a time limit of 5–10 working days:

blocks.zh: 計算錯誤審查（確認數值計算是否正確）
blocks.en: Review of calculation errors (confirm that the numerical calculations are correct)

blocks.zh: 樣品準備審查（稀釋步驟、濃度換算）
blocks.en: Review of sample preparation (dilution steps, concentration conversions)

blocks.zh: 儀器校正狀態確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of instrument calibration status

blocks.zh: 試劑/標準品有效期確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of reagent/reference standard expiry

blocks.zh: 分析員資格確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of analyst qualification

blocks.zh: 方法是否正確遵循
blocks.en: Whether the method was followed correctly

blocks.zh: Phase I 結論只有兩種：
blocks.en: There are only two possible Phase I conclusions:

blocks.zh: 確認 Assignable Cause： 找到明確可確認的實驗室錯誤（如儀器故障、錯誤稀釋）→ 可宣告原始結果無效（Invalid Assay），進行重新測試
blocks.en: Assignable cause confirmed: A clear, confirmed laboratory error is found (such as instrument malfunction or an incorrect dilution) → the original result may be declared invalid (invalid assay) and a retest performed

blocks.zh: 未找到 Assignable Cause： 結果為真實（genuine） OOS → 進入 Phase II
blocks.en: No assignable cause found: The result is a genuine OOS → proceed to Phase II

blocks.zh: Phase II — 全面調查（Full-Scale Investigation）
blocks.en: Phase II: Full-Scale Investigation

blocks.zh: 由 QCU 主導，Phase I 不能解釋的 OOS 必須進入 Phase II：
blocks.en: Led by the QCU; any OOS that Phase I cannot explain must proceed to Phase II:

blocks.zh: 製程調查： 審查批次生產記錄——有無設備故障、製程偏差、操作員錯誤
blocks.en: Process investigation: Review the batch production record for equipment malfunctions, process deviations, and operator errors

blocks.zh: 物料調查： 審查使用的原料批次——是否有同一原料批次用於其他批次
blocks.en: Materials investigation: Review the raw material lots used, including whether the same raw material lot was used in other batches

blocks.zh: 工廠調查（Plant Investigation）： 擴大至其他批次，如指出的系統性問題
blocks.en: Plant investigation: Extend to other batches where a systemic problem is indicated

blocks.zh: 追加測試（Additional Testing）： 可以在 Phase II 進行額外測試，但必須有預先批准的計畫；額外結果不可選擇性使用
blocks.en: Additional testing: Additional testing may be performed in Phase II, but only under a pre-approved plan; the additional results may not be used selectively

blocks.zh:
重要原則：「所有結果必須報告（All Results Must Be Reported）」
Phase II 中所有測試的所有結果——無論合格或不合格——都必須記錄。不可以因為後面的結果合格就刪除前面的不合格結果。
blocks.en:
Key principle: "All Results Must Be Reported"
All results of all tests in Phase II, whether passing or failing, must be recorded. Earlier failing results may not be deleted because later results pass.

blocks.zh: 何時可以宣告 Invalid Assay？
blocks.en: When Can an Invalid Assay Be Declared?

blocks.zh: 這是 OOS 管理中最容易濫用、也是 FDA 查廠最仔細審查的議題。
blocks.en: This is the topic in OOS management most prone to abuse, and the one FDA inspectors examine most closely.

blocks.zh: 合法的 Invalid Assay 宣告：必須具備已確認的 Assignable Laboratory Cause
blocks.en: A legitimate invalid assay declaration requires a confirmed assignable laboratory cause

blocks.zh: HPLC 儀器停機並記錄到系統問題
blocks.en: HPLC instrument shutdown with the system problem documented

blocks.zh: 分析員操作過程中確認發生定量轉移錯誤
blocks.en: A quantitative transfer error by the analyst during the operation is confirmed

blocks.zh: 標準品到期或貯存條件不符
blocks.en: Reference standard expired or stored under non-conforming conditions

blocks.zh: 系統適用性（System Suitability）測試失敗
blocks.en: System suitability test failure

blocks.zh: 不合法的 Invalid Assay 宣告（FDA 常常發現）：
blocks.en: Illegitimate invalid assay declarations (frequently found by FDA):

blocks.zh: 「因為結果看起來不合理（the result seems unlikely）」
blocks.en: "Because the result seems unlikely"

blocks.zh: 「重測結果合格，所以原始結果可能是錯的」
blocks.en: "The retest passed, so the original result may be wrong"

blocks.zh: 「分析員表示當天感覺操作沒有問題，但也不確定」
blocks.en: "The analyst said he felt he had performed the work correctly that day, but was not certain"

blocks.zh: 「依照 SOX 統計原則移除離群值」（未事先在 SOP 中規定移除規則）
blocks.en: "Removing outliers under SOX statistical principles" (with no outlier removal rule specified in advance in an SOP)

blocks.zh: Barr Laboratories 案（1993）的歷史影響
blocks.en: The Historical Impact of the Barr Laboratories Case (1993)

blocks.zh: 1993 年，美國聯邦地區法院（Judge Alfred Wolin）在 United States v. Barr Laboratories 案中做出裁決，成為 OOS 調查的法律基石。
blocks.en: In 1993, the US Federal District Court (Judge Alfred Wolin) issued its ruling in United States v. Barr Laboratories, which became the legal cornerstone of OOS investigations.

blocks.zh: 核心裁決（摘要）：
blocks.en: Core rulings (summary):

blocks.zh: OOS 結果在找到 Assignable Laboratory Cause 之前，不可進行重測
blocks.en: An OOS result may not be retested before an assignable laboratory cause has been found

blocks.zh: 統計學平均法（Averaging）不能用來「稀釋」不合格結果——每個單獨的 OOS 結果都必須被調查
blocks.en: Statistical averaging may not be used to "dilute" a failing result; every individual OOS result must be investigated

blocks.zh: 重測的樣品數和條件必須預先規定，不能事後調整
blocks.en: The number of retest samples and the conditions must be specified in advance and cannot be adjusted after the fact

blocks.zh: 「不合格結果只是偶發事件」的假設在沒有科學依據的情況下不可接受
blocks.en: The assumption that "a failing result is just an isolated event" is not acceptable without scientific justification

blocks.zh: 此案判決後，FDA 花了 13 年才在 2006 年正式將這些原則寫成指引文件。但在此之前，FDA 查廠官員已經以此判決為依據發出 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: After this ruling, FDA took 13 years to formally write these principles into a guidance document in 2006. Before that, however, FDA inspectors were already issuing 483 observations based on this decision.

blocks.zh: All Original Data 原則 — 數據完整性的核心
blocks.en: The "All Original Data" Principle: The Core of Data Integrity

blocks.zh: §211.194(a)(6) 要求保存「all original data」，包括圖表和光譜。這在數位時代有具體含義：
blocks.en: §211.194(a)(6) requires retention of "all original data", including charts and spectra. In the digital age, this has specific meaning:

blocks.zh: HPLC/UPLC 數據文件必須保存原始 .raw 或 .cdf 格式，不可只保存 PDF 報告
blocks.en: HPLC/UPLC data files must be retained in the original .raw or .cdf format, not just as PDF reports

blocks.zh: 系統不可允許用戶刪除或覆蓋序列（sequence）
blocks.en: The system must not allow users to delete or overwrite sequences

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤（Audit Trail）必須記錄所有變更，包括誰在何時修改了什麼
blocks.en: The audit trail must record all changes, including who changed what and when

blocks.zh: 「測試、失敗、刪除、重測」的模式是最嚴重的數據完整性違規——可導致 Consent Decree 或刑事起訴
blocks.en: A "test, fail, delete, retest" pattern is the most serious data integrity violation, and can lead to a consent decree or criminal prosecution

blocks.zh: 5.5a §§211.170–211.176 — Reserve Samples, Lab Animals & Penicillin Contamination 5.5a §§211.170–211.176 — 留樣、實驗動物與青黴素污染
blocks.en: 5.5a §§211.170–211.176 — Reserve Samples, Lab Animals & Penicillin Contamination

blocks.zh: §211.170 留樣（Reserve Sample）的實務管理
blocks.en: Practical Management of §211.170 Reserve Samples

blocks.zh: 留樣制度的設計目的是：當產品在市場上發生問題（客訴、召回）時，能夠追溯測試原始批次。
blocks.en: The reserve sample system is designed so that when a problem arises in the market (complaint, recall), the original batch can be traced and tested.

blocks.zh: 「兩倍量」的含義： 足以進行所有法規要求的測試（不含無菌和熱原測試），但仍需兩份以上——一份日常年度目視檢查用，一份保留作為潛在訴訟/調查證據。
blocks.en: The meaning of "twice the quantity": Enough to perform all required regulatory tests (excluding sterility and pyrogen tests), but still at least two portions: one for the routine annual visual inspection, and one retained as potential litigation/investigation evidence.

blocks.zh: 貯存條件： 必須與產品標示一致（not merely room temperature）。若產品需冷藏（2–8°C），留樣也需冷藏——這是常見的 483 項目，尤其是當設備出現溫度異常時。
blocks.en: Storage conditions: Must be consistent with the product labeling (not merely room temperature). If the product requires refrigeration (2–8°C), the reserve samples must also be refrigerated; this is a common 483 item, especially when equipment has a temperature excursion.

blocks.zh: 年度目視檢查： 必須有記錄，通常由倉庫人員執行並由 QA 審查。若留樣外觀出現任何變化（顏色、沉澱、結晶），需要通知 QCU 並評估是否觸發穩定性調查。
blocks.en: Annual visual inspection: Must be documented, usually performed by warehouse personnel and reviewed by QA. If the reserve sample shows any change in appearance (color, precipitate, crystals), the QCU must be notified and a decision made on whether to trigger a stability investigation.

blocks.zh: §211.176 青黴素污染 — 零容忍政策
blocks.en: §211.176 Penicillin Contamination: Zero-Tolerance Policy

blocks.zh: 青黴素/頭孢菌素的微量污染對過敏患者具有致命危險。FDA 的立場是：可偵測到的（detectable）青黴素汙染 = 不得上市，無論污染程度多低。
blocks.en: Trace contamination with penicillins/cephalosporins can be fatal to allergic patients. FDA's position is: detectable penicillin contamination = the product may not be marketed, however low the level of contamination.

blocks.zh: 這是 FDA 對 GMP 廠房中青黴素類產品「專用設施（dedicated facility）」要求的法規依據。大多數國際法規（EU GMP, PIC/S）也有類似要求，但 21 CFR 的文字最為嚴格——沒有「可接受的最低污染量」標準。
blocks.en: This is the regulatory basis for FDA's requirement of a dedicated facility for penicillin-class products in GMP plants. Most international regulations (EU GMP, PIC/S) have similar requirements, but the wording of 21 CFR is the strictest: there is no "acceptable minimum contamination level" standard.

blocks.zh: 5.5b §§211.180–211.186 — Records: General Requirements, Equipment Logs & Master Records 5.5b §§211.180–211.186 — 紀錄：一般要求、設備日誌與主紀錄
blocks.en: 5.5b §§211.180–211.186 — Records: General Requirements, Equipment Logs & Master Records

blocks.zh: §211.182 設備清潔日誌 — 多用途設備的關鍵記錄
blocks.en: §211.182 Equipment Cleaning Log: A Key Record for Multi-Product Equipment

blocks.zh: 設備清潔日誌（Equipment Cleaning and Use Log）是預防交叉污染的文件核心。FDA 查廠時特別關注：
blocks.en: The Equipment Cleaning and Use Log is the documentation cornerstone of cross-contamination prevention. FDA inspectors pay particular attention to:

blocks.zh: 每批次使用前是否確認設備已清潔
blocks.en: Whether the equipment is confirmed clean before each batch

blocks.zh: 最後一個使用批次的產品名稱和批號是否記錄（用於評估清潔效果）
blocks.en: Whether the product name and lot number of the last batch run are recorded (used to evaluate cleaning effectiveness)

blocks.zh: 清潔後的「最大保持時間（Maximum Hold Time after Cleaning）」是否已驗證
blocks.en: Whether the Maximum Hold Time after Cleaning has been validated

blocks.zh: 清潔有效期到期後是否重新清潔並記錄
blocks.en: Whether the equipment is re-cleaned and recorded once the cleaning expiry period lapses

blocks.zh: §211.182 的例外條款：專用設備不需要個別設備日誌，可以將清潔記錄併入批次記錄。但「專用」的定義是永久僅用於一種產品——如果設備有時也生產其他產品，仍需個別設備日誌。
blocks.en: Exception in §211.182: dedicated equipment does not need an individual equipment log, and cleaning records may be incorporated into the batch record. But "dedicated" means permanently used for only one product; if the equipment is sometimes used to make other products, an individual equipment log is still required.

blocks.zh: §211.186 MPR（主生產記錄）的「全簽名」要求
blocks.en: §211.186 The "Full Signature" Requirement for the MPR (Master Production Record)

blocks.zh: §211.186(a) 明確要求 MPR 的準備和核查必須使用 「full signature, handwritten」（完整手寫簽名），而不是縮寫或印章。這一點在電子化環境下需要特別注意：
blocks.en: §211.186(a) expressly requires that the preparation and checking of the MPR use a "full signature, handwritten", not abbreviations or stamps. This needs special attention in an electronic environment:

blocks.zh: 電子 MPR 也必須符合此要求 → 必須使用 21 CFR Part 11 合規的電子簽名
blocks.en: An electronic MPR must also meet this requirement → a 21 CFR Part 11-compliant electronic signature must be used

blocks.zh: 「縮寫（initials）」不足——MPR 需要完整簽名，但其他記錄（如設備日誌）可接受縮寫
blocks.en: "Initials" are not enough: the MPR needs a full signature, although other records (such as equipment logs) may accept initials

blocks.zh: MPR 的核查人（second person check）必須獨立執行，不可與準備人為同一人
blocks.en: The checker of the MPR (second person check) must perform the check independently and may not be the same person as the preparer

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限計算
blocks.en: Calculating the Record Retention Period

blocks.zh: §211.180 的記錄保存期限計算有一個容易混淆的地方：
blocks.en: There is one easily confused point in how the §211.180 retention period is calculated:

blocks.zh: 例：一個批次有效期為 2028-12-31，其批次記錄必須保存至 2029-12-31。
blocks.en: Example: a batch with an expiration date of 2028-12-31 must have its batch records kept until 2029-12-31.

blocks.zh: 注意：這只是 21 CFR 的最低要求。歐盟 GMP（EU GMP Annex 15）和許多其他法規要求保存更長時間（通常為有效期後 5 年）。跨國運營的公司應以最嚴格的法規為準。
blocks.en: Note: this is only the minimum requirement of 21 CFR. EU GMP (EU GMP Annex 15) and many other regulations require longer retention (usually 5 years after expiry). Multinational companies should follow the strictest regulation.

blocks.zh: 5.6 §211.196–§211.198 — Distribution Records & Complaint Files 5.6 §211.196–§211.198 — 配銷紀錄與客訴檔案
blocks.en: 5.6 §211.196–§211.198 — Distribution Records & Complaint Files

blocks.zh: §211.196 分銷記錄 — 召回作業的基礎
blocks.en: §211.196 Distribution Records: The Foundation of Recall Operations

blocks.zh: 分銷記錄（Distribution Records）在日常運營中可能顯得不起眼，但一旦需要召回（Recall），它的重要性立刻凸顯：
blocks.en: Distribution records may seem unremarkable in day-to-day operations, but once a recall is needed, their importance becomes immediately clear:

blocks.zh: FDA 要求召回廠商能在 24–72 小時內識別哪些批次流向了哪些通路
blocks.en: FDA expects a recalling firm to identify within 24–72 hours which batches went to which channels

blocks.zh: §211.196 要求的資訊（名稱、強度、批號、收貨人名址、日期、數量）是精確追蹤的最低要素
blocks.en: The information required by §211.196 (name, strength, lot number, consignee name and address, date, quantity) is the minimum for precise tracing

blocks.zh: 若分銷記錄不完整，FDA 可能要求「有意義（meaningful）」的召回被擴大為「I 級召回（Class I）」——最高程度
blocks.en: If distribution records are incomplete, FDA may require a "meaningful" recall to be expanded to a Class I recall, the highest level

blocks.zh: CDMO 注意：CDMO 出貨給品牌商後，品牌商對最終通路分銷負責。但 CDMO 必須保存自己的分銷記錄（記錄到品牌商這一層）。品質協議應明訂在召回發生時的數據共享義務。
blocks.en: CDMO note: after the CDMO ships to the brand owner, the brand owner is responsible for distribution to the final channels. But the CDMO must keep its own distribution records (down to the brand owner level). The quality agreement should specify data-sharing obligations when a recall occurs.

blocks.zh: 投訴信號偵測（Signal Detection from Complaint Trending）
blocks.en: Signal Detection from Complaint Trending

blocks.zh: §211.198 的文字著重於個別投訴的處理，但 FDA 的期望已進化：
blocks.en: The text of §211.198 focuses on the handling of individual complaints, but FDA's expectations have evolved:

blocks.zh: 年度產品回顧（APR，§211.180(e)） 中，應對投訴數據進行趨勢分析（trending）：
blocks.en: In the Annual Product Review (APR, §211.180(e)), complaint data should be trended:

blocks.zh: 投訴率（complaints per million units distributed）是否有上升趨勢？
blocks.en: Is the complaint rate (complaints per million units distributed) rising?

blocks.zh: 特定類型的投訴（異物、顏色變化、無效投訴）是否在某個時期集中出現？
blocks.en: Are specific types of complaints (foreign matter, color change, ineffectiveness) clustered in a particular period?

blocks.zh: 地理聚集（geographic clustering）是否暗示特定通路的溫控問題？
blocks.en: Does geographic clustering suggest a temperature control problem in a particular distribution channel?

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System 將投訴趨勢分析納入「改進與創新（Continual Improvement）」的必要輸入。
blocks.en: The ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System makes complaint trend analysis a required input to Continual Improvement.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：投訴處理的責任分工
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Division of Responsibility for Complaint Handling

blocks.zh: CDMO 製造、品牌商銷售的架構下，投訴處理的責任劃分必須在品質協議（Quality Agreement）中明確規定：
blocks.en: Where the CDMO manufactures and the brand owner sells, the division of complaint handling responsibilities must be clearly set out in the Quality Agreement:

blocks.zh: 誰接收消費者投訴？ 通常是品牌商，因為消費者不知道誰製造了產品
blocks.en: Who receives consumer complaints? Usually the brand owner, because consumers do not know who manufactured the product

blocks.zh: 誰進行品質調查？ 若投訴涉及製造批次問題，CDMO 的 QCU 主導調查
blocks.en: Who conducts the quality investigation? If the complaint involves a manufacturing batch problem, the CDMO's QCU leads the investigation

blocks.zh: 誰通知 FDA？ NDA 持有者（通常是品牌商）負責 IND/NDA 不良事件申報
blocks.en: Who notifies FDA? The NDA holder (usually the brand owner) is responsible for IND/NDA adverse event reporting

blocks.zh: 召回決定： NDA 持有者做決定，CDMO 提供支援（批次記錄、調查報告）
blocks.en: Recall decision: The NDA holder decides, and the CDMO provides support (batch records, investigation reports)

blocks.zh: 記錄保存： 雙方各自保存相關記錄，互相提供副本
blocks.en: Record retention: Each party keeps the relevant records and provides copies to the other

blocks.zh: 投訴 vs. 不良事件：何時必須向 FDA 申報？
blocks.en: Complaint vs. Adverse Event: When Must It Be Reported to FDA?

blocks.zh: §211.198(a) 要求廠商評估投訴是否構成必須申報的 「serious and unexpected adverse drug experience」。
blocks.en: §211.198(a) requires the firm to evaluate whether a complaint constitutes a reportable "serious and unexpected adverse drug experience".

blocks.zh: 「嚴重（Serious）」的定義（21 CFR 312.32）：導致或可能導致死亡、危及生命、住院、殘疾、先天性異常，或需要醫療干預以防止永久傷害的事件。
blocks.en: Definition of "Serious" (21 CFR 312.32): an event that results in, or may result in, death, a life-threatening condition, hospitalization, disability, a congenital anomaly, or that requires medical intervention to prevent permanent harm.

blocks.zh: 5.7 §§211.204–211.208 — Subpart K: Returned and Salvaged Drug Products 5.7 §§211.204–211.208 — Subpart K：退回與搶救藥品
blocks.en: 5.7 §§211.204–211.208 — Subpart K: Returned and Salvaged Drug Products

blocks.zh: §211.204 退貨藥品的「疑義即銷毀」原則
blocks.en: §211.204 The "When in Doubt, Destroy" Principle for Returned Drug Products

blocks.zh: §211.204 建立了一個重要的舉證責任原則：退貨藥品的默認處置是銷毀，除非有充分證據（檢驗和測試）證明其符合標準。
blocks.en: §211.204 establishes an important burden-of-proof principle: the default disposition of a returned drug product is destruction, unless adequate evidence (examination and testing) shows that it meets standards.

blocks.zh: 「疑義產生的情境」——以下任一情況即可觸發強制銷毀：
blocks.en: Situations that raise doubt: any one of the following can trigger mandatory destruction:

blocks.zh: 貯存或運輸溫度記錄缺失或異常
blocks.en: Storage or shipping temperature records are missing or abnormal

blocks.zh: 包裝外觀損壞（容器、紙箱、標籤）
blocks.en: The packaging is visibly damaged (container, carton, label)

blocks.zh: 退貨原因涉及產品效果或安全性投訴
blocks.en: The reason for return involves a complaint about product efficacy or safety

blocks.zh: 貯存場所環境條件不明（如自然災害後的退貨）
blocks.en: The environmental conditions of the storage location are unknown (for example, returns after a natural disaster)

blocks.zh: 許多公司的 SOP 直接規定「所有退貨均銷毀，不進行再利用」——這是最簡單的合規策略，雖然在商業上損失較大，但避免了所有監管風險。
blocks.en: Many companies' SOPs simply state "all returns are destroyed and not reprocessed or resold". This is the simplest compliance strategy: although it is commercially costly, it avoids all regulatory risk.

blocks.zh: §211.208 自然災害後的藥品處置
blocks.en: §211.208 Disposition of Drug Products After Natural Disasters

blocks.zh: §211.208 主要針對極端情況：颶風、水災、火災、倉庫停電等。重點：
blocks.en: §211.208 mainly addresses extreme circumstances: hurricanes, floods, fires, warehouse power outages, and the like. Key points:

blocks.zh: 感官檢查（Organoleptic Examination）只是補充性證據——「看起來沒壞」不足以允許重新上市
blocks.en: Organoleptic examination is only supplementary evidence: "it looks fine" is not enough to permit re-marketing

blocks.zh: 必須有實驗室測試（laboratory assays）的正面結果
blocks.en: There must be positive results from laboratory assays

blocks.zh: 必須有對受災現場環境條件的評估文件
blocks.en: There must be documented assessment of the environmental conditions at the affected site

blocks.zh: 「無法進行實驗室測試的，必須銷毀」——不設例外
blocks.en: "Product that cannot be laboratory tested must be destroyed": no exceptions

blocks.zh: FDA 在重大自然災害後（如卡崔娜颶風、波多黎各瑪麗亞颶風）都對受影響廠商發出指引，要求廠商主動識別可能受影響的批次。
blocks.en: After major natural disasters (such as Hurricane Katrina and Hurricane Maria in Puerto Rico), FDA issued guidance to affected firms, asking them to proactively identify potentially affected batches.

blocks.zh: 退貨處理 SOP 設計要點
blocks.en: Key Design Points for a Returns Handling SOP

blocks.zh: 退貨接收時立即隔離（標示「QUARANTINE」，不可混入合格品區域）
blocks.en: Quarantine returns immediately on receipt (label "QUARANTINE"; never mix with the released product area)

blocks.zh: 記錄退貨原因、退貨者、退貨日期、批號
blocks.en: Record the reason for return, who returned it, the return date, and the lot number

blocks.zh: 評估貯存條件：客戶有無提供溫度記錄？
blocks.en: Evaluate storage conditions: did the customer provide temperature records?

blocks.zh: QCU 決策矩陣：哪些情況直接銷毀？哪些可以測試後評估再利用？
blocks.en: QCU decision matrix: which cases are destroyed outright, and which may be tested and then evaluated for reuse?

blocks.zh: 所有退貨記錄必須與原批次批次記錄連結（§211.204 末句要求）
blocks.en: All return records must be linked to the batch record of the original batch (required by the last sentence of §211.204)

blocks.zh: 統計退貨率並納入年度產品回顧（APR）
blocks.en: Trend the return rate and include it in the Annual Product Review (APR)

blocks.zh: 本章總結 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: Subparts I–K 的整體監管邏輯
blocks.en: The Overall Regulatory Logic of Subparts I–K

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211 的 Subparts I–K 構成了藥品製造的「質量保證閉環」：
blocks.en: Subparts I–K of 21 CFR 211 form the "closed loop of quality assurance" in drug manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 實驗室建立科學基礎（Subpart I）： 方法驗證確保測試有效；穩定性測試確立有效期；留樣確保可追溯性
blocks.en: The laboratory builds the scientific foundation (Subpart I): Method validation ensures the tests are valid; stability testing establishes the expiry period; reserve samples ensure traceability

blocks.zh: 記錄捕捉每一個行動（Subpart J）： 設備日誌、原料記錄、批次記錄——構成完整的製造歷史
blocks.en: Records capture every action (Subpart J): Equipment logs, component records, and batch records together make up the complete manufacturing history

blocks.zh: QCU 做出最終判斷（§211.192）： Thorough review 確保不合格批次不進入市場
blocks.en: The QCU makes the final judgment (§211.192): Thorough review ensures that nonconforming batches do not reach the market

blocks.zh: 偏差與異常得到調查（§211.192 + §211.194）： OOS 程序確保問題不被掩蓋
blocks.en: Deviations and anomalies are investigated (§211.192 + §211.194): The OOS procedure ensures problems are not covered up

blocks.zh: 問題從市場回饋到工廠（§211.198）： 投訴處理閉環，信號偵測觸發改進
blocks.en: Problems feed back from the market to the plant (§211.198): Complaint handling closes the loop, and signal detection triggers improvement

blocks.zh: 異常產品不得流通（Subpart K）： 退貨和搶救的嚴格管控保護消費者
blocks.en: Abnormal product must not circulate (Subpart K): Strict control of returns and salvage protects consumers

blocks.zh: CDMO 特別提示：五大責任邊界
blocks.en: CDMO Special Note: Five Responsibility Boundaries

blocks.zh: 批次放行： CDMO 的 QCU 有最終決定權，不可被客戶覆蓋
blocks.en: Batch release: The CDMO's QCU has the final decision and cannot be overridden by the client

blocks.zh: OOS 調查： CDMO 主導實驗室調查（Phase I），品牌商可參與 Phase II 製程調查
blocks.en: OOS investigation: The CDMO leads the laboratory investigation (Phase I), and the brand owner may take part in the Phase II process investigation

blocks.zh: 穩定性： NDA 持有者設計計畫，CDMO 提供批次並執行
blocks.en: Stability: The NDA holder designs the program, and the CDMO supplies batches and executes it

blocks.zh: 投訴： 品牌商接收投訴，製造問題由 CDMO 調查
blocks.en: Complaints: The brand owner receives complaints, and manufacturing issues are investigated by the CDMO

blocks.zh: 記錄保存： 雙方各自負責保存，品質協議明訂存取權利
blocks.en: Record retention: Each party is responsible for its own retention, and the quality agreement specifies access rights
